thread.title_full: Weber County AMBER alert canceled, missing teen found in Colorado - NewsBreak

author: Amelia Hobson
title: Weber County AMBER alert canceled, missing teen found in Colorado - NewsBreak
text:
By Amelia Hobson ,
5 hours ago
UPDATE 11/26 7:20 p.m.: According to the Department of Public Safety (DPS), the AMBER alert has been canceled. The parents also confirmed with ABC4 that the teenager and the suspect were found in Colorado on Wednesday.
Ogden Police Department says that they received a tip of a missing juvenile around 2:00 p.m. and issued an AMBER alert due to information about the suspect, Christopher Thomas Wiggins.
Documents detail AMBER Alert suspect`s sex offense conviction Later, around 7:00 p.m., Larimer County Sheriff’s Deputies in Colorado located and apprehended Wiggins. The missing 13-year-old was also located safely and is being looked after in Fort Collins, Colorado, while her family travels to the area.
Multiple agencies are investigating this incident, including the Ogden Police Major Crimes Bureau and federal partners. Ogden Police Department (OPD) says they are still determining the extent of criminal charges but will not be releasing any additional information at this time.
OPD also thanked the public for the many tips shared throughout the day, as well as the assistance from partner agencies in Colorado.
‘I’m going to get my daughter’: Family speaks after missing teen found in Colorado “When incidents like this occur, the Ogden Police Department will relentlessly pursue those who threaten the safety of our residents, especially our children. Our officers will leverage every available tool and resource to track down offenders and bring them to justice,” Chief Jake Sube with OPD said, “With the suspect now in custody, we will work closely with prosecutors to ensure the case is pursued to the fullest extent of the law.”
Chief Sube added, “I want to thank our community for its vigilance in rapidly sharing information across Utah and neighboring states. I am also grateful to our partnering law enforcement agencies whose support was critical in bringing this case to a successful and safe conclusion.”
Original Story 11/26, 5 p.m.:
WEBER COUNTY, Utah ( ABC4 ) — An AMBER Alert has been issued for a missing 13-year-old who may have been abducted by a non-family member.
The state has issued an AMBER Alert for the teenager and said that her life may be in danger. If you see the following individuals or vehicle, you can call 911 or 801-395-8221.
The suspect is Christopher Thomas Wiggins who is a family acquaintance.
Court documents indicate that Wiggins is a registered sex offender and was previously found guilty of two counts of attempted unlawful sexual activity with a minor in 2011.
